name: placement_basic
kind: survey: on which pc and as which class the hardware books the time a warp is held by (1) a try_wait whose traced run took the out-of-line retry loop, (2) MEMBAR.ALL.CTA + FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S, (3) DEPBAR.LE behind cp.async, (4) BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING followed by instructions of 14 kinds; installs nothing
why: Stage 1 (wait placement) of dev/design/stall-attribution.md. full-mio4, per-pc residency error by site kind against the error of the site's total (points of hardware residency, H100 / B300): mbarrier poll 23.3 / 54.3 against 3.6 / 4.9, CTA barrier 10.6 / 12.1 against 3.0 / 4.3, DEPBAR sites 5.9 / 5.4 against 1.2 / 1.0, fence 0.9 / 1.6 with class long_scoreboard on hardware (0.47 / 1.13 on FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S behind MEMBAR.ALL.CTA, 0.25 / 0.99 on a BAR.SYNC behind the fence) where the replay books control_floor -> wait (0.53 / 1.56). The time is roughly right in these sites; the pc (and for the fence the class) is not.
data_seen_before_freezing: The full-mio4 comparison and the read-only aggregations of this session (~/tmp/mechver-look: per-pc error by site kind; hardware barrier samples behind a BAR by parked mnemonic and by the mnemonics between the BAR and the parked pc; long_scoreboard on the instruction behind DEPBAR: BAR.SYNC, LDS, UIADD3, UISETP, ULEA).

One median full-GPU case per device: hardware waits on the reader of the inline try_wait (a BRA) with no residency in the out-of-line NANOSLEEP.SYNCS loop, the replay on the loop pcs (the traced run entered the loop, the fold keeps the last successful poll).

sync_basic v4 / v5 addenda (u.handoff: wait on the reader of the try_wait's predicate, 1.96 microsecond time-out; hint form: wait on NANOSLEEP.SYNCS; the captures of u.handoff.k64 / .k256 / .k1024 have 241795 / 828883 / 3171718 dropped polls, i.e. the traced run fails polls the native run does not), branch_basic v1 addendum (a warp with a pending BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING issues the adds and the clock read behind it and stops on LDC (h100) / LDCU (b300), on the next BAR, or on a BRA; class barrier there), s.membar_cta / s.membar_gl (class membar on the instruction behind MEMBAR), plan_pilot v1.
No hand-written cell has FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S in front of anything but SYNCS, a DEPBAR, an out-of-line retry loop, or other instruction kinds behind a BAR.

probe.chain: As sync_basic / mio_basic: hand-written PTX (probe/u.pollcute.ptx, s.fence.ptx, s.fence0.ptx, s.fence_sts8.ptx, s.fence_bar.ptx, s.cpasync.ptx, s.cpasync_lds.ptx) and plans on the frame probe/b.loop.ptx (gen_b.py, the gen_m.py producer texts and control words), ptxas -O3 -> (sass_patch) -> nvdisasm loop gate -> ptx_runner; cells in sync_basic/cells.tsv, suite rows set placement_basic; build dir $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/microbench/placement_basic/<device>/build, run root $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/placement_basic/<device>; direct clocks, capture, two reference passes, replay with build 370bf919.

cells.poll: u.pollcute.k0, .k64, .k256, .k1024: leader / follower pairs as u.handoff (two warps per CTA, one CTA per SM, delay loop of k iterations in front of each arrive); each wait is one inline try_wait without a hint and, when it returns false, a retry loop of the hint form (TRYWAIT, NANOSLEEP.SYNCS, PHASECHK) at other pcs.
cells.fence: s.fence0 (fence.proxy.async.shared::cta alone), s.fence and s.fence.w4 (one 4-byte shared store in front), s.fence_sts8 and s.fence_sts8.w4 (eight stores in front), s.fence_bar and s.fence_bar.w4 (one store, the fence, then bar.sync 0).
cells.cp.async: s.cpasync, s.cpasync.w4: cp.async of 16 bytes global -> shared per thread, commit_group, wait_group 0, then the loop's add / compare / branch; s.cpasync_lds, s.cpasync_lds.w4: the same with a shared load of the copied word and an add of it behind the wait.
cells.bar: b.<kind>.w8 for kind in nop, shf_lop (the frame's own SHF / LOP3 pair), imad, fadd, ffma, uiadd3, r2ur, cs2r, s2r, s2ur, lds, shfl_bfly, vote, mufu: eight warps per CTA arrive together at BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING; the two slots behind it hold the kind, the third a constant-bank load (LDC on h100, LDCU on b300), the others NOPs.

probe.unrealised: A form that cannot be built is recorded in tools/microbench/placement_basic/unrealised.txt before the run and its cells are left out.

readings: Per cell and device, per-warp cycles per iteration from the per-pc samples of both passes and from the replay ledger: every loop pc with its hardware classes and the replay's reasons; the capture's dropped_polls for the poll cells.

questions_before_data.Q1: Poll: at k = 0, 64, 256 (wait shorter than the time-out) the hardware books the wait on the reader of the inline try_wait's predicate and nothing on the retry loop, while the replay books it on the retry loop's pcs? At k = 1024: how many cycles per wait stay on the inline reader (expected about 3876) and where the rest goes (NANOSLEEP.SYNCS, the reader of PHASECHK)?
questions_before_data.Q2: Fence: on which pc (MEMBAR.ALL.CTA, FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S, the instruction behind) and as which class (membar, long_scoreboard, wait) is the time booked, how does it depend on the number of stores in front and on the warps of the SM, and does a BAR.SYNC behind the fence carry part of it?
questions_before_data.Q3: DEPBAR.LE behind cp.async: is the wait booked on the DEPBAR itself, on the next instruction, or on the first instruction that is not plain arithmetic; class long_scoreboard?
questions_before_data.Q4: BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING: for each kind, is the class barrier on the first instruction of the kind (the kind stops the warp) or on the constant-bank load behind the two (the kind is issued while the barrier is pending)?

install: Nothing. Readings go into the addenda; the installation protocol placement follows.
not_allowed: No value from another machine or from the literature; no full-GPU case used to choose a rule; no cell dropped after its data is seen.

addenda.when: 2026-11-19 / 20, run placement_basic-r2 (clone stall-attribution-36, commit 96280f17; jobs mechver-place2-h100 / -b300; roots $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/placement_basic-r2/{h100,b300}; replay build 370bf919). The first roots placement_basic/{h100,b300} are void (VOID.txt: the b.* plans gave slot 0 stall 1 and the loop compare read the counter one instruction early, check word 65). 28 cells per device (b.r2ur unrealised): direct values right, captured, two reference passes rc 0; H100 replayed, B300 hardware readings from reference-a (its replay was still running)
addenda.text: Per-warp cycles from the per-pc samples; a row holds the waits in front of that pc's issue and, as class selected, the issue cycle of the instruction the warp issued before it (55 taken back-edges per device in the earlier cells: selected 1.04 / 1.03 on the fall-through pc of a taken branch, 0.00 on its target). Q1 POLL. k = 0, 64, 256 (direct runs: 0 out-of-line polls per wait): the whole wait is long_scoreboard on the reader of the inline try_wait's predicate (the BRA behind it: k64 408 / 405 per wait on H100, 390 on B300) and the out-of-line loop has 0.00, although ncu's instruction-count pass and the capture run it (dropped_polls 21226 / 288760 / 994060 at k0 / k64 / k256 on H100): the traced and the counted runs take the loop, the sampled native run does not. The replay books the wait on the loop's pcs (k64, per wait: NANOSLEEP.SYNCS 391 and 316, the loop's BRA 10 and 74, against hardware 0) and nothing on the inline reader. k = 1024 (1.00 out-of-line poll per wait): inline reader long_scoreboard 3876.6 / 3876.8 (H100), 3877.1 (B300) = the 1.96 microsecond time-out; the rest on NANOSLEEP.SYNCS as long_scoreboard (734 / 853 H100, 599 B300), 11 on the loop's BRA, 3 + 2 of class wait on the loop's TRYWAIT / PHASECHK. Q2 FENCE. MEMBAR.ALL.CTA itself carries no wait. The time between MEMBAR and FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S is on the FENCE's pc: class wait 4.1-6.4 (the MEMBAR's stall 6) plus long_scoreboard 1.4-2.9 with no store in the loop, 3.1-5.9 behind one store, 7.3 (H100) / 7.0 (B300) behind eight. Control words: MEMBAR.ALL.CTA carries a read barrier, FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S waits for it and writes a dependency barrier of its own, the BAR.SYNC behind it has that barrier in its wait mask. With a BAR.SYNC behind the fence the BAR's pc carries long_scoreboard 17.9-21.7 (H100, 1 and 4 warps), 17.8 (B300) and the next pc (STS) the CTA barrier (class barrier 8.5-9.2 at 1 warp, 13.1-16.5 at 4); without an instruction that waits for the fence's barrier (s.fence, s.fence_sts8) nothing behind the fence waits for it. The replay books control_floor 7 / 11 / 14 (0 / 1 / 8 stores) + suspended:descriptor_visibility 9 (+ unit:fence_view_async_sm 8.8 at 4 warps) on the FENCE's pc and 3-4 on the BAR: cycles hardware / replay s.fence0 1537 / 1983, s.fence_sts8 3372 / 3950, s.fence_bar 4103 / 3557, s.fence_bar.w4 4611 / 4547 (the fence's result is a dependency barrier on hardware, a hold of the warp in the replay: a mechanism difference beyond placement). Q3 DEPBAR. DEPBAR.LE itself carries only its issue; the wait is long_scoreboard on the instruction directly behind it whatever its kind (LDGSTS 291-319, LDS 289-296 / 299-326 B300, the loop's BRA 295), 1 and 4 warps alike. The replay books async_group_wait 489 on the DEPBAR (cycles 22898 / 32952 in s.cpasync, 23934 / 33752 in s.cpasync_lds: the copy's completion takes two thirds longer in the replay, not a placement matter). Q4 BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING (8 warps arriving together; BAR stall 2, slot 0 two cycles behind it, the frame's ISETP, slot 1 six cycles behind the BAR, the constant load): identical on both devices. Class barrier (15.8-20.3 per iteration) is on the constant load (LDC / LDCU) for imad, fadd, ffma, uiadd3, cs2r, vote, shf_lop (these kinds and ISETP are issued while the barrier is pending) and on the SECOND instance (slot 1) for s2r, s2ur, lds, shfl_bfly, mufu and for nop; the first instance (slot 0, two cycles behind the BAR) is issued whatever its kind. With the earlier cells (u.bar_late: IMAD.IADD and CS2R issued, stop on LDC; u.bar_late3; s.bar: VIADD and ISETP issued, stop on the next BAR and on BRA; s.fence_bar: ISETP issued, stop on STS): the warp stops on the first instruction that is not one of IMAD, FADD, FFMA, UIADD3, CS2R, VOTE, SHF, LOP3, ISETP, IADD3, VIADD, except that an instruction reached two cycles behind the BAR is issued in any case; measured stops: NOP, S2R, S2UR, LDS, SHFL.BFLY, MUFU, LDC, LDCU, STS, BAR, BRA, all six or more cycles behind the BAR. Three to five cycles behind the BAR is not measured. Nothing is installed from these readings.
